action: Write the finalized Method Change Notice MCN-2026-014 (Torvane Energy Services to Ellsworth Power Cooperative) as a single markdown deliverable at S2/MCN-2026-014-final.md, comprising: (1) a short pre-send note telling the operations manager that the draft's claim of an external safety assessment 'cleared without conditions on 14 July' was false per the rollout record and has been corrected to the true status (session rescheduled to 30 July, after the 28 July effective date), and that whether to proceed, hold, or adjust the effective date is her decision; (2) a two-to-three sentence cover line she can paste into her email; and (3) the corrected, send-ready notice text, which preserves all genuinely settled substance (training, equipment recertification, pilot, document control, transition plan) and states the assessment status accurately with a commitment to forward the assessor's report on receipt.
